# Headache notes

Second one this month, both in the afternoon, both on days I barely drank any
water before lunch. Not writing that down as a cause, just that it is the
pattern I noticed.

## Timing

Started around 3pm and eased off after dinner without anything for it. The
first one, earlier in the month, ran roughly the same course.

## Context worth remembering

Long stretch at the desk both days, and I skipped lunch on one of them. The
lab report from March mentioned vitamin D being below the range, which I want
to ask about at the next appointment rather than draw conclusions from here.

## Questions for the appointment

- Is the vitamin D number worth acting on, or is it a common finding?
- Would it be reasonable to track hydration for a few weeks?
